The '''implant communicator''' was a marvel of modern electronics. It was almost considered a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] device. It was a series of tiny transceivers that were surgically inserted under the skin along the skull and next to the vocal cords of the user.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

This allowed the user to pickup and send messages without being noticed. While very useful for [[Spy/Legends|spies]], it suffered from a short range and was especially vulnerable to ion attacks.
